subject: Prorated credit calculation + final invoice reconciliation for Q2 renewal
messages:
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@greenfield.software>
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Cc: Greenfield Software Finance <ap@greenfield.software>
Date: 2027-03-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Prorated credits and final invoice for upcoming renewal

Hi Evelyn,

Hope you’re well — our renewal is up at the end of April and Finance asked me to confirm how the prorated credits from our expansion earlier this quarter will be reflected on the final invoice. Specifically:

- Which months will be credited and what line items change?
- Will credits reduce the base subscription invoice or be issued as a separate credit memo?
- Any VAT implications on the credit (we’re EU-registered but billing address is in the US)

Can you share the reconciled schedule and the final invoice draft so we can route to AP? We need to get this into our April payment run.

Thanks — Sarah
Sarah Liu
Head of Billing Operations
Greenfield Software
[Attachment: GF_expansion_order_20270115.pdf]

From: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@greenfield.software>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-03-29T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Prorated credits and final invoice for upcoming renewal

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear list. I pulled together a short reconciliation and next steps; see summary below and attached schedule.

Summary (high level):
- Prorated credit covers the expansion effective 2027-02-15 through 2027-04-30 (we applied a pro rata credit for unused dedicated capacity during Feb 15–28).
- Credit amount: USD 18,450 (this will be posted as a credit memo and netted against the Q2 invoice).
- Invoice impact: final invoice will show gross charges (USD 62,300), then Credit Memo: USD -18,450, then Net Due: USD 43,850.
- VAT: because the contract is with a US-entity subsidiary and services were delivered from US regions, the credit will be processed without EU VAT on our side; your team should determine any VAT reporting on your end.

Attachments I’m sending: prorate schedule (Excel) and a draft final invoice PDF. Marissa — can you confirm we’re able to issue a credit memo and net it on the same invoice in your system? Aditya — flagged you to confirm the GL code and that this won’t delay the April payment run.

Next steps:
1) Marissa to confirm credit memo / invoice netting and provide final invoice number.
2) Evelyn to push the finalized invoice and credit memo to DocuSign/Finance link.
3) Sarah to confirm AP run window; if same month, we’ll target collection by 04/25.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Manager, Renewals
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Greenfield_final_prorate_schedule.xlsx]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@greenfield.software>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-03-29T12:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Prorated credits and final invoice for upcoming renewal

Thanks Evelyn — confirming on process.

Operational notes:
- We will issue a Credit Memo CM-2027-0419-017 for USD 18,450 and will apply it against Invoice INV-2027Q2-089 which we expect to finalize today.
- Netting in our billing system is supported; the AP portal will show both the gross invoice and the applied credit memo with the net due amount.
- GL mapping: use Revenue account 4321 (SaaS — subscription) for the gross, and Contra-Revenue 4321-C for the credit memo. Aditya, I linked the GL in the ERP — confirm if you need a different account.
- VAT: We will not apply US sales tax/VAT on the credit memo; if Greenfield requires a VAT-stamped credit for their EU reporting, let us know and we can add additional VAT fields (this is unusual but doable).

I’m attaching the draft invoice and will upload the signed credit memo once Evelyn confirms the wording.

[Attachment: GF_invoice_2027Q2_draft.pdf]

—Marissa
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@greenfield.software>
Date: 2027-03-29T13:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Prorated credits and final invoice for upcoming renewal

Quick confirmation from Finance:
- GL mapping is good as Marissa noted.
- No blocking issues for your April run as long as we finalize invoice by EOD 03/29 and push the documents to the AP link.
- Payment terms remain Net 30 from invoice date (INV-2027Q2-089 will show issue date 2027-03-29; due 2027-04-28).
- I also confirmed that credit memo will not be treated as a taxable supply by Redwood for US VAT/sales tax purposes. Please have Greenfield confirm VAT treatment on their side if they need EU-compliant documentation.

aditya

From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@greenfield.software>
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-03-29T15:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Prorated credits and final invoice for upcoming renewal

All good on our end — thanks for the quick turnaround. We’ll route INV-2027Q2-089 and CM-2027-0419-017 to AP today.

Two quick asks before close:
1) Can you include a short invoice line explaining the credit reason ("prorated capacity credit: 2027-02-15 to 2027-04-30") so our PO reconciliation picks it up automatically?
2) If there’s any externally visible invoice/credit reference (DocuSign or portal link), drop it here so we can attach to our payment batch.

If you can confirm both, I’ll mark this as ready for payment.

Best,
Sarah
Greenfield Software
[Attachment: AP_contact_info.vcf]
